sentences.en: The chimney needs repointing; the mortar between the bricks has eroded.
sentences.zh: 烟囱需要重新勾缝；砖缝间的灰浆已经侵蚀掉了。

sentences.en: The number of minority seats in the Lower House is rapidly eroding.
sentences.zh: 下议院中的少数派席位正在迅速减少。

sentences.en: Capitalism tends to erode the moral foundations on which it was built.
sentences.zh: 资本主义往往会侵蚀其建立的基础道德原则。

senses.zh: 侵蚀，腐蚀vi.逐渐毁坏,削弱，损害
